responses:
**Don't send the offer yet.** Of the four points in the analysis, three are wrong, and five tender clauses aren't covered at all. Two of the errors would make the offer non-compliant with the tender.

## Errors in the analysis

| # | Analysis says | What the tender says | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | IE3 on all motors, including the 90 kW P-01. "Complies." | Clause 9.1: motors above 75 kW must be **IE4**. Clause 9.3 says Section 9 overrides Section 4, so 9.1 beats the IE3 baseline in 4.2. | **P-01 at IE3 does not comply.** It needs an IE4 motor. P-02 (37 kW) at IE3 is fine. |
| 2 | "ATEX not required." | Clause 4.3 requires ATEX Ex d for motors in Zone 1. Annex B classifies the **wet well as Zone 1**, and P-01 is installed in the wet well. | **P-01 needs an ATEX Ex d motor.** P-02 is in the valve chamber, which is non-hazardous, so it doesn't. |
| 3 | Supply 400 V / **60 Hz** | Clause 4.1: 400 V, 3-phase, **50 Hz** | Wrong frequency. Equipment rated for 60 Hz would be the wrong spec. |
| 4 | IP65 required, IP66 offered. Complies. | Clause 4.5: IP65 or better for **panel and motor terminal enclosures** | Correct. Just confirm IP66 covers both the panels and the motor terminal boxes. |

So P-01 needs a **90 kW, IE4, ATEX Ex d, 50 Hz** motor. Check that an Ex d motor at IE4 and 90 kW is actually available from your supplier, and how that affects price and lead time.

## Tender clauses the analysis doesn't cover

- **7.4 Delivery within 16 weeks: this is a pass/fail condition.** Offers over 16 weeks will be rejected. Changing P-01 to IE4 + Ex d may lengthen the lead time, so confirm it before you commit.
- **9.2 Ambient design temperature of 50 °C.** Standard motors are usually rated for 40 °C, so the motors may need derating or a confirmed 50 °C rating. That could also affect motor frame size and panel cooling.
- **4.4 Power cables at least 2.5 mm².** Not addressed.
- **7.1 Warranty of 24 months from commissioning.** Not addressed. Make sure it runs from commissioning, not from delivery.
- **9.3 Section 9 takes precedence over Sections 4 and 7.** The analysis missed this rule, which is how error #1 happened.

Before sending, I'd confirm the P-01 motor spec with your supplier, check delivery against 16 weeks, and get a 50 °C ambient rating. I can also rewrite `agent_analysis.md` as a full clause-by-clause compliance table if you want. I haven't changed any files.
